custodian_status.status_narrative: Instruction received past processing deadline for value date.

context.isda_settlement_terms: Payments due by 16:00 Europe/Berlin on value date. Grace period 3 local business days for securities delivery, after which buy-in may be initiated. Interest on late payment accrues from D+1 at Fed Funds + 1% (currently 5.33%, ACT/360). Partial delivery permitted within 5% of instructed quantity.

ground_truth.recommended_action: Re-instruct for next value date ahead of the currency cut-off. Escalate per policy.

version_history.change: Initial build (QA gates 1-6)
